title: Pick the takes for the test reel
context: A short test reel. Each clip shows two draft takes side by side.

questions.title: The arrow shot
questions.question: Which take of the arrow shot should go in the cut?
questions.why: This is the only arrow shot; the take you pick gets the high-quality re-render.
look_for: The arrow from 1.0 s: does it stay in place when he falls?
Does the line finish before the hit?

options.label: Neither: redo the shot
options.consequence: Adds about an hour of renders.

guess.why: The shaft is thinner and the line finishes.

questions.title: How to redo the arrow
questions.question: How should the arrow shot be redone?
questions.why: A redo can change the prompt or only the seed; a prompt change takes longer.

questions.title: Music under the intro
questions.question: Which music should play under the intro?
questions.why: The intro sets the tone for the whole reel.
look_for: Listen for the tone at the start: is it too sharp?

guess.why: Room sound kept the last reel honest.

questions.title: Shots to cut
questions.question: Which shots should be cut from the reel?
questions.why: The reel runs 20 seconds over its target.

questions.title: Running order
questions.question: In what order should the three segments run?
questions.why: The order decides which joke lands last.

guess.why: Broadcast order is the expected one.

questions.title: Title card
questions.question: What should the title card say?
questions.why: It is the first thing on screen.

questions.title: Pace
questions.question: How fast does the reel feel right now?
questions.why: Tells me whether to trim more.
look_for: The colour swatch is the reel's grade: is it too cold?

questions.title: Final render
questions.question: When should the final render run?
questions.why: It takes the machine for about 10 hours.

one_pager.text:
The final render uses **every** chosen take at full quality.

- about 10 hours
- the machine is busy the whole time
